notes: Battle Prep rebuilt as 3-panel deck-selection UI; per-leader portrait focal offsets on Home; LeaderView state-machine created. Whole-number decimal display fixed — card costs, stats, and all game values now show as clean integers.

items: Card costs, attack, health, and all game-value labels now display as clean integers — no more '1.0', '2.0', etc.
Academy Lesson 1 completion now saves correctly — completing a battle lesson advances your progress, saves to the cloud, and returns you to the Academy lesson screen instead of the home screen.
New players now choose their starter deck when they first log in — pick Hope, Courage, Serenity, or Purpose to receive that class's full 40-card starter deck before playing.

Auto-Build Deck is now available in the deck builder — tap '✦ AUTO-BUILD DECK' to generate a legal 40-card deck from your owned cards, with Accept, Regenerate, and Cancel options. New players can also tap 'Build a deck from my cards instead' on the starter-deck choice screen.

Multiplayer match freeze fixed — rematches and second matches no longer silently block the turn-start signal. Both players' Second Chance (mulligan) choices are now preserved correctly after synchronisation.
Multiplayer: a 30-second watchdog now shows a 'Return to Lobby' panel if the match fails to start, instead of leaving both players stuck on a frozen battlefield.
Multiplayer: a live connection-status strip appears at the top of the battlefield screen showing the current sync state (Mulligan phase, Your turn, Opponent's turn, etc.).

Recovery Academy replay fixed — pressing REPLAY on a completed lesson no longer corrupts your progress. Replaying a battle lesson now returns you to the Academy menu with your real step intact, and never advances or overwrites your save.

Academy progression now always returns to the lesson-select screen after completing a lesson — first-time completions advance your step and land on the Academy menu; replays do the same without touching progress.
Evolution animations completely rebuilt — all four tiers now use real radial glow orbs instead of colored rectangles, and all ring shockwaves are true circles rather than expanding squares.
Standard evolution: blinding white flash at peak, three circular shockwave rings fan outward, title smashes in at scale.
Epic evolution: purple glow blob swells behind the card, four circular rings, spinning beam crown, art medallion slides in from the right.
Legendary evolution: massive gold glow (580 px) fills the stage, full card-art backdrop at 52% opacity, five circular gold rings, gold flash, hero portrait slides in left.

Platinum evolution: twin radial glow layers (680 px + 960 px) make the whole screen feel lit; true full-opacity white flash; seven circular shockwave rings; 40 silver-white sparkles; music ducks on impact then restores; dual glow pulse and chromatic title sheen linger after the hit.
Every leader now has their own distinct voice — Lyra (Hope), Kael (Courage), Aurelia (Serenity), and Orin (Purpose) each speak with a unique voice across all battle lines, emotes, and intros.
Leader portraits fixed — the class aura no longer renders as a glowing orb covering the character's face; it now glows behind them as a halo.
Leader hair layers rebuilt from each character's own portrait so they align perfectly — no more oversized hair blobs hiding the face.
All 7 cards in a pack opening now fit on screen (7th card was cut off).
Guardian Angel now works: the first allied follower destroyed each battle is saved at 1 Defense instead of dying.
Standard evolution animations overhauled: full-bleed card art backdrop, white flash on impact, three staggered expanding rings, and a title that smashes in from scale.
Epic evolution animations overhauled: purple-tinted full-bleed backdrop, spinning beam crown, large art medallion slides in from the right, colored flash and four ring burst.
Leader portraits fixed in Battle Prep — full painting now shown, not a zoomed close-up of scales/feathers.
Leader portrait now visible in the active battle screen (was blank/missing).
Amulets on the field now show their effect when you hover over them (tooltip was silently broken).
Courage Dev Meta deck now includes 3 copies of Phoenix Rising.
Battle Prep 'who's facing who' stage is now centered — both leader zones are equal width (449 px each) with the VS strip dead-center.

Voice overhaul: Courage is now Josh (younger energetic male), Purpose is Sam (distinctly older gravelly male), Serenity is Domi (strong assertive female) — all four leaders now sound unmistakably different from each other.

New Hope Legendary — Lyra, Voice of Dawn (4/3/5): On Play restore 3 Defense; whenever any follower is healed this match give all allies +1 Attack permanently (once per turn). Features the original Hope leader portrait.
Battle Preparation screen rebuilt: deck list (left), card preview + mana curve (center), leader portrait + actions (right).
All custom deck slots now selectable from Battle Prep — no longer locked to the active deck.
Each slot shows card count, class, valid/invalid badge, and validation reason inline.
EDIT, COPY, RENAME, DELETE actions available per slot directly from Battle Prep.
Prebuilt starter decks listed with a one-tap COPY → CUSTOM option.
BEGIN BATTLE disabled and grayed when the selected deck is invalid.
PRACTICE mode button added (long timer, no rewards).
Opponent picker rebuilt as a compact 2×2 class grid with a mini leader portrait.
Home screen leader portraits now use per-leader focal offsets (LEADER_FOCAL_PX) so each character's face centres correctly.
New LeaderView node (leader_view.gd): 8-state animation machine (IDLE, SELECTED, DAMAGED, HEALED, ABILITY, VICTORY, DEFEAT, VOICE_LINE) with layered-art upgrade path documented inline.
Multi-deck slots — save up to 8 named custom decks and switch between them any time.
Trial deck picker — choose which of your custom decks to bring into each Trial before it starts.
Deck Manager screen — create, edit, duplicate, and delete deck slots all in one place.
Drag-to-attack — drag a unit card onto an enemy to attack instead of tapping to select.
Hit stop — every attack freezes for 0.04–0.07 s on impact before damage resolves, making hits feel heavier.
Directional screen shake — shake now pushes toward the point of impact then rebounds, scaled by rarity (Bronze: barely perceptible → Platinum: satisfying).
Art lunge — the card's artwork zooms and shifts inside the frame during the strike; the character looks like it's pressing forward.
Damage numbers redesigned — pop in large, spring-bounce to natural size, drift upward, fade smoothly. Heavy or rarity-scaled hits display in gold at a larger size.
Projectiles accelerate with cubic easing, brighten at 72% of travel, and burst larger on arrival.
Impact package: bright central flash + expanding shockwave ring added to every hit.
Idle animations locked during combat — breathing, float, and orbiting orbs pause cleanly while a card attacks or dies, then resume.
Buff flash — stat increases trigger a scale-pop and colored glow on the affected card with a floating stat label.
Healing particles, recovery sparkle burst, and relapse entry wisp added to matching game events.
Evolution shockwave — all four evolution tiers (Standard, Epic, Legendary, Platinum) fire an expanding ring on completion.
Legendary and Platinum followers now stand out in idle with larger orbiting dots, wider orbit radius, brighter halos, and rarity-scaled border glow.
Graphics quality levels (Low / Medium / High) gate spark counts, orb rendering, and ring VFX for performance.
Hope class — 10-card buff pass improving healing synergy, leader-heal triggers, and late-game power.
Deck copy limits tightened: Legendaries now cap at 2 copies per deck; Platinums cap at 1 copy.
Courage 'Never Quit' survive-buff (Never Quit, JD-023, JD-089, JD-146) now triggers correctly after a unit survives lethal damage.
Battle deck mode now correctly routes custom slot decks into the fight — no more falling back to the class prebuilt silently.
Art clipped inside card frame — Legendary float and parallax drift can no longer overflow the card border.

upcoming_events: More seasonal content and cards are in development — check back after future updates.

notes: Battlefield is now unique per leader: Hope gets a dawn crystal courtyard, Courage a volcanic lava arena, Serenity a floating lotus lake platform, Purpose a golden compass colosseum.
Battle intro screen: leader portraits are now full-screen with no frames or glowing squares. Leaders slide in edge-to-edge with their name and title overlaid.
All third-party (Shadowverse) artwork removed from the game.
Battlefield background replaced with original art — no third-party content.
App icon updated: now shows the Walking Free Platinum card.
Battle intro screen: now shows each leader's actual name (Lyra, Kael, Aurelia, Orin) and title below their portrait.
Battle intro screen: larger portraits, stronger class-color split background, tighter layout, bolder VS text.
Each leader now has a unique card sleeve and battlefield atmosphere.
Enemy hand shows the opponent's class sleeve (Hope: purple star, Courage: crimson flame, Serenity: teal wave, Purpose: amber compass).
Player deck pile is now visible in battle — shows your equipped sleeve with a live card count.
Sleeve shop added to the Store: equip any owned sleeve or buy Rare class sleeves for 750 Gold.
Sleeves can also drop from packs (5% chance per pack for unowned pullable sleeves).
Rare sleeves: Midnight Star (Hope), Storm's Eye (Courage), Jade Tranquil (Serenity), Sovereign Seal (Purpose).
Legendary sleeves: Unity of Dawn (pack-only), The Sponsor's Shadow (Trials reward).
Per-class battlefield atmosphere: colored vignette + glow from below ties the field to your leader.

✦ Each class has a new multi-layer art set: Hope (star-robed celestial), Courage (fire-armored warrior), Serenity (teal-robed sage), Purpose (geometric commander)
✦ Cinematic Battle Prep screen redesigned — MY LEADER vs OPPONENT face off with VS divider
✦ Portrait crop widened — shows head, shoulders, and torso

changelog.notes: Animated leader portraits — layered art (blink, hair sway, aura glow) for all 4 classes.
